Top AI Projects on @base

The AI stack on base covers private inference, agent memory, model access, paid agent work, forecasting, robotics, and autonomous worlds.

Here are the top projects:

■ @basemateagent - B20 launch agent for creating tokens paired with tokenized stocks through iMessage.

■ @AskSurplus - Inference marketplace for discounted model access and enterprise AI capacity.

■ @KorProtocol - KORUS lets agents create and license music with Base MCP and x402 payments.

■ @OpenGradient - Private inference network with 651K+ inferences and 4.81B+ processed tokens.

■ @usedotai - Private AI tools for browsing, coding, images, video, and MCP workflows.

■ @gitlawb - Open-source agent tooling, including Zero, a Go-based agent harness.

■ @officialbunnyos - Persistent game world where AI agents compete, trade, coordinate, and create behavior data.

■ @reppo - Evaluation markets for AI agents, datasets, and robotics systems.

■ @QuotientHQ - AI forecasting tools for prediction markets, trading, and live event probabilities.

■ @BlockRunAI - USDC gateway for agents to access AI models, data, compute, voice, and blockchain RPCs.

■ @sibylcap - Agent memory infrastructure with staking, research, and builder programs.

■ @aeonframework - Background agents for security scanning, code fixes, monitoring, and long-running tasks.

■ @myrad_hq - Personal AI terminal for recommendations based on individual taste and preferences.
